svg.title: Zoe is Quale. Zoe is Red. Accessible Q-Volume and IIT 2009.

g.title: subtitle
g.text: ZOE IS RED · ZOE IS GEM · GEM IS ZOE

g.title: source
g.text: A visual field guide to Balduzzi & Tononi (2009)

g.title: scope
g.text: Causal geometry, not a consciousness score

g.title: repertoire-caption
g.text: COPY: detector ON means sensor was ON. EI = 1 bit.

g.title: lattice-note
g.text: Alternative mechanism orders, not activity unfolding in time.

g.title: context-caption
g.text: Nested subshapes, not brain regions or measured experience.

g.title: tomography-title
g.text: 05 / ACCESSIBLE Q-VOLUME · A PROPOSED THRESHOLD ANNOTATION

g.title: tomography-independence
g.text: Volume can rise or fall. Phi and gamma stay separate.

g.title: tomography-counts
g.text: Counts alone: state labels may be permuted

g.title: tomography-finite
g.text: Finite grid: approximation, not exact recovery

g.title: tomography-arrow
g.text: Each arrow: EI + delta + entering + exiting

g.title: tomography-boundary
g.text: An annotation, not a replacement for IIT.

g.title: tomography-caption
g.text: One threshold instrument, two directions. No causal model is inferred from a forecast.

g.title: footer
g.text: Read the mechanism. Preserve the repertoire. Question the interpretation.

g.title: footer-boundary
g.text: GUIDE, NOT AN IIT CALCULATOR · no Phi assigned to Zoe · no subjective-experience claim
